name: ADHD Online
one_liner: Self-paced online ADHD and mental health evaluation read by a psychologist, with optional telehealth medication and therapy for adults.
best_for: Adults, teens or children 6 and over who want an ADHD evaluation without a waitlist
Adults who want follow-on medication management or therapy by video after diagnosis
People paying out of pocket, or with HSA/FSA funds, who can file their own out-of-network claims
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want their insurance billed directly, or who use Medicaid or Medicare
Children and teens who need ongoing treatment (treatment is adults 18+ only)
People in states where medical treatment is not offered
short_description: ADHD Online (Mentavi Health) sells a $219 online diagnostic evaluation reviewed by a doctorate-level psychologist, plus adult telehealth medication.
long_description: ADHD Online, now operating as Mentavi Health, offers an online mental health diagnostic evaluation: you complete a self-paced questionnaire and a doctorate-level psychologist reviews it and writes a report. The evaluation costs $219 (or three payments of $73), is for ages 6 and up, and is available nationwide. Adults can then book medical treatment ($199 first visit, $185 follow-ups) in 40+ states, therapy at $220 a session where offered, or coaching at $59 a session. Stimulant prescribing is decided case by case by the treating clinician. ADHD Online does not bill insurance or take Medicaid or Medicare, but provides superbills for out-of-network claims and accepts HSA/FSA. A 2025 company-funded study in the Journal of Clinical Psychiatry compared its online assessment with clinician video interviews in 345 adults and found 78% agreement, with the online tool diagnosing ADHD less often.

pricing.notes: Evaluation can be split into 3 payments of $73. Therapy $220/session and coaching $59/session for adults. No direct insurance billing; superbills for out-of-network claims; HSA/FSA may be used; Medicaid, Medicare and CareCredit not accepted.

privacy.notes: Clinical records fall under a notice of privacy practices that says data is never sold, but the website runs Google, Meta, TikTok and other ad pixels once you accept ad cookies (disabled in CA, NV, MD, CO and WA).

seo.meta_description: ADHD Online provides comprehensive ADHD assessments and telehealth treatment with board-certified providers, including medication management.

faqs.q: What does ADHD Online's assessment include?
faqs.a: The assessment includes standardized questionnaires, clinical interview components, and cognitive testing. It's more comprehensive than basic screenings, providing detailed information about attention, executive function, and whether you meet criteria for ADHD.

faqs.q: How much does ADHD Online cost?
faqs.a: The initial assessment costs around $199-299. Treatment plans with ongoing medication management are subscription-based. Some insurance plans cover treatment visits. The assessment fee is typically self-pay.

ADHD Online providers can prescribe FDA-approved ADHD medications including stimulants when clinically appropriate. Controlled substance telehealth prescribing has regulations that vary by state. Verify current availability for your state.

faqs.q: What ages does ADHD Online serve?
faqs.a: ADHD Online serves adults and adolescents ages 12 and older. The assessment and treatment are designed for teens and adults, not younger children who may need specialized pediatric evaluation.

primary_uses: Adult ADHD medication management by video

clinical_trials.study: Validity of the online assessment against clinician video interviews

citation.authors: Herman BK, Faraone SV, Cutler AJ, Newcorn JH, LaFrance EM, Ripper Lewis M, Ruetsch C
citation.title: Validity of an Online Assessment of Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Among a Real-World Sample of Adults Seeking Web-Based Mental Health Care

clinical_trials.outcome: 78% agreement with clinical interview (sensitivity 80.6%, specificity 44.0%); the online tool diagnosed ADHD less often. Funded by Mentavi Health.
clinical_trials.study_design: Cross-sectional diagnostic accuracy study, no treatment outcomes

availability.note: Evaluation nationwide for ages 6+; medication treatment and therapy for adults only, in 40+ states.

patient_summary: You answer an online questionnaire at your own pace, and a psychologist reviews it and sends you a diagnostic report; the evaluation costs $219. If you are an adult in a covered state, you can then see a clinician by video for medication ($199 first visit, $185 follow-ups) or book therapy. You pay yourself; insurance is not billed directly, but you can submit a superbill.
